statements.statement: The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias and assess the efficacy of current rate-control management
